[[Duck Hunt Event|Duck Hunt]] |first_wave_appearance = N/A |base_hp = [[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]50 |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Average (3) |spawned_by = [[Operator Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Operator Ducky]] |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = None |ability1 = '''{{WikiAb|License to Kill}}''' - The '''Agent Ducky''' takes out its gun and shoots a tower, stunning it for a period of time. }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Agent Ducky''' was an enemy that appeared exclusively in [[D00M's Revenge]] as part of the [[Duck Hunt Event]]. Currently, it can be spawned again in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It had a somewhat high health and an average speed. It has one ability, its ''License to Kill'' ability, which causes it to fire its pistol at a tower, which stuns it. The '''Agent Ducky''' was spawned by the [[Operator Ducky (D00M's Revenge)|Operator Ducky]] and never spawned naturally. ==Appearance== The '''Agent Ducky''' is a yellow duck with black eyes and an orange beak. It wears a black fedora, translucent shades and suit and had black feet. It wields a Luger pistol which it uses to stun towers. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[D00M's Revenge]] is listed instead. *High DPS towers with fast firerate, like the [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] are great against this. **You can use the [[Commander]] to decrease their firerate. *The [[Medic]] can be used to cleanse stuns from towers hit by the '''Agent Ducky'''. *As these spawn in groups, towers that can hit multiple enemies, like the [[Executioner]] can do well against this. *Towers with short range, such as the [[Sledger]] can be easily stunned by the '''Agent Ducky''', as they need '''Agent Ducky''' very close to them so that they can attack it. **Because of how the [[D00M's Revenge]] map works, you should generally avoid bringing towers with short range, as enemies come from all sides of the map. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyAgentDuck.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (16 April 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} LegacyAgentDuckyIconIG.png|'''Agent Ducky''' on its icon. }} ==Update History== *'''17 April 2022''' - [[v1.2.0]] **'''Agent Ducky''' added. *'''28 May 2022''' - [[v1.2.4]] **'''Agent Ducky''' removed. *'''16 April 2025''' - [[v1.61.0]] **'''Agent Ducky''' can now be summoned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, only when the player has the [[Agent Ducky (Ducky Revenge)|Agent Ducky]]'s from [[Ducky Revenge Event]] [[Logbooks|Logbook]]. **{{Bug}} Luger pistol no longer disappears after shooting a tower. {{ZombieNavBox}} {{DISPLAYTITLE:Agent Ducky}} [[Category:D00M's Revenge]]
